entries.title: Psalms 36:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David the servant of the LORD.>> An oracle within my heart concerning the transgression of the wicked: [There is] no fear of God before his eyes.

entries.title: Psalms 36:2
segments: For he flatters himself in his own eyes, When he finds out his iniquity [and] when he hates.

entries.title: Psalms 36:3
segments: The words of his mouth [are] wickedness and deceit; He has ceased to be wise [and] to do good.

entries.title: Psalms 36:4
segments: He devises wickedness on his bed; He sets himself in a way [that is] not good; He does not abhor evil.

entries.title: Psalms 36:5
segments: ¶Your mercy, O LORD, [is] in the heavens; Your faithfulness [reaches] to the clouds.

entries.title: Psalms 36:6
segments: Your righteousness [is] like the great mountains; Your judgments [are] a great deep; O LORD, You preserve man and beast.

entries.title: Psalms 36:7
segments: How precious [is] Your lovingkindness, O God! Therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of Your wings.

entries.title: Psalms 36:8
segments: They are abundantly satisfied with the fullness of Your house, And You give them drink from the river of Your pleasures.

entries.title: Psalms 36:9
segments: For with You [is] the fountain of life; In Your light we see light.

entries.title: Psalms 36:10
segments: Oh, continue Your lovingkindness to those who know You, And Your righteousness to the upright in heart.

entries.title: Psalms 36:11
segments: Let not the foot of pride come against me, And let not the hand of the wicked drive me away.

entries.title: Psalms 36:12
segments: There the workers of iniquity have fallen; They have been cast down and are not able to rise.
